title: Product category identifier (proposed demo demand)
practical_value: Proposed field-role demand in 1 demos. Preserve source value; external reference matching requires evidence.
licence_notes: Candidate metadata is unreconciled. Per-input data/model/meaning licences remain in demand-plan.json and recordset records; Employees-derived evidence retains CC-BY-SA-3.0. No blanket CC0 or canonical new meaning licence is asserted.
reason:
Related concepts, entity keys/names/attributes and physical roles remain separately qualified in assertions. Coverage means inspected hypothesis presence, not accepted semantic equivalence or external match rate.

Phase 2 UNRESOLVED: Each classification needs scheme, edition and source definition. A local status/category/title/genre code cannot be joined to another scheme by equal value. Assignment and correspondence require evidence; splits/merges may be many-to-many. Preserve source codes and nulls; no automatic NAICS/SOC/ISCO/GTIN assignment. Definition gap: the candidate combines source roles or lacks a sufficiently bounded reusable definition and binding domain. Retain the candidate; do not infer absence from literal query results. Examined 2 physical field-role hypotheses for this group; their individual dispositions govern implementation.
